purpose: Connect property documents and verified facts to canonical legal propositions and final answers.
chain: DOCUMENT -> EXTRACTED_FACT -> VERIFIED_EVIDENCE -> LEGAL_PROPOSITION -> LEGAL_RULE -> LEGAL_EFFECT -> ANSWER

evidence_record.legal_effect: effect established by the evidence and applicable law

rules: An extracted fact cannot become a verified legal proposition without source verification where verification is required.
A document can support a proposition without proving every proposition about the property.
Conflicting evidence remains visible and is not silently resolved.
Historical evidence retains its event date and applicable legal version.
A source can support facts while a different primary legal source determines legal effect.
Current legal answers must not silently use superseded evidence.
